column1: This is where you put your Options Contracts to upload them to TraderVault.
- Direction must be BUY or SELL.
- Type must be CALL or PUT.
- Premium/Share is the per-share premium (not per contract). One contract = 100 shares.
- Leave Close Date blank for open contracts — they will be added to your current positions.
- Fill in Close Date for expired or closed contracts — they will be added to your History.
- If you recorded open and close entries separately combine them into one row here.
- Use MM/DD/YYYY format for all dates.
